text: The local Langlands correspondence for $GL_n(\mathbb{Q}_p)$ matches irreducible smooth representations of $GL_n(\mathbb{Q}_p)$ with representations of a finite symmetric group.
explanation: It is FALSE: the correspondence (Harris-Taylor, 2001) matches those smooth representations with $n$-dimensional representations of the Galois group $\mathrm{Gal}(\bar{\mathbb{Q}}_p/\mathbb{Q}_p)$, not a symmetric group. Symmetric groups arise in classical Schur-Weyl duality, which is unrelated to this arithmetic correspondence.
